title: WorldCore Atlas Manual
summary: Use regions and hazards as readable route intelligence instead of invisible background rules.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: WorldCore publishes region and hazard context so the world can explain itself. The same route can become safer when you know what pressure is active.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Open the Wiki regions and hazards pages, identify your current context, and carry equipment that answers the active hazard instead of generic supplies.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Enter region, read hazards, prepare counters, complete a focused objective, and update your map or base notes before pushing further.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Regions, hazards, active snapshots, and discovery progress all shape what the player sees and when. Treat each warning as a preparation clue.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Ashfall uses WorldCore heavily, WeatherCore can add pressure, HoloMap can show context, and Index or Wiki can link the same region to items and missions.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a hazard feels invisible, check whether WorldCore is loaded, whether this route has region data, and whether the current biome or structure matches the hazard rules.
